asks: How much of today do you actually remember?
description: A person stands here in unremarkable clothes doing an unremarkable thing, and they have your face on. Not a likeness. Yours, including the parts you wouldn't have been able to describe.
emotes: {it} scratches its cheek, your cheek, and carries on with what it was doing.
{it} catches your eye, gives a small apologetic smile, and looks away first.
{it} adjusts its collar in a gesture you have made perhaps ten thousand times.
looks: It's doing your face better than you do. Nothing about it's exaggerated and that's the problem.
When you move your hand, it doesn't copy you. It's simply somebody else, wearing this.
The expression is one you have never seen from the inside and now recognise instantly.
name: somebody wearing your face
says: I'm not doing anything you would not.
